summary: Stock warning system fully implemented and tested. Backend calculates available stock correctly, excluding completed rows and accounting for allocations. Frontend validates on Order Qty blur, displays clear warnings, and blocks submission without acknowledgment. All 9 test scenarios pass. Excel import allows selective override with audit trail. Database schema extended for acknowledgment metadata. Ready for production.

findings.description: Stock calculation correctly excludes completed rows using $expr comparison and applies TODAY boundary for allocation dates
findings.suggested_fix: No action needed — implementation verified correct

findings.description: Tooltip functionality in LacquerPlan list view depends on Bootstrap JS initialization. If parent app doesn't globally initialize Bootstrap tooltips, badges won't show hover details.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tooltip initialization after component mount if Bootstrap JS not globally configured: document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').forEach(el => new bootstrap.Tooltip(el))

findings.description: Race condition possible if stock allocations change between preview and commit (another user creates plan). This is by design — recalculation at commit time catches and re-warns on retry.
findings.suggested_fix: No action needed — acceptable design trade-off. Document in deployment notes if needed.

findings.description: Incoming Plan allocation calculation assumes items array exists with bottleId and qty fields. Verify Incoming schema compatibility.
findings.suggested_fix: Cross-check Incoming model definition to confirm field names and structure match current code expectations.
